categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the Internet of Things (IoT) sector, focusing on the design, research and development, production (via outsourced manufacturing), and sales of IoT wireless communication modules, terminals, communication solutions, and cloud products including cloud platforms and cloud infrastructure. Its products serve various applications such as smart energy (electricity, water, gas), vehicle networking, urban IoT sensing, mobile broadband IoT, commercial retail, and industrial IoT.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company masters five core foundational technologies: cellular communication, reliability technology, application layer protocols, baseband and RF technology, embedded software, and cloud platform technology. It develops advanced wireless communication modules supporting 2G to 5G including NB-IoT, Cat-M, and V2X standards, integrating AI technologies into IoT modules and terminals. Production is outsourced to specialized manufacturing partners mainly in the Pearl River Delta region, with strict quality and technology control to protect core intellectual property.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include government entities, large enterprises, and industry players in smart energy (notably national and regional power grids), vehicle networking (OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers), urban sensing platforms, and cloud infrastructure clients such as data centers and intelligent computing centers. The company serves both domestic Chinese markets and international markets including India, Southeast Asia, Europe, and North America.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant market presence in multiple Chinese regions including Shenzhen, Dongguan, Xi'an, and others. It also has expanding overseas operations targeting India, Southeast Asia, the Middle East, Europe, and North America, with a focus on smart grid and vehicle networking markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the IoT supply chain, focusing on product design, R&D, and sales. It outsources manufacturing to third-party factories and procures key components such as chips from domestic and international suppliers. It provides integrated solutions combining hardware modules, terminals, cloud platforms, and cloud infrastructure, positioning itself as a comprehensive IoT solution provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing 5G and 4G wireless communication technologies, developing AI-integrated IoT modules and terminals, and expanding cloud platform and infrastructure capabilities. The company invests in R&D centers across Shenzhen, Dongguan, and Xi'an, focusing on industrial-grade, automotive-grade, and AI-enabled products. It emphasizes innovation in low-power, high-stability, and secure wireless communication modules and aims to lead in smart energy, vehicle networking, urban sensing, and cloud computing integration.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of IoT wireless communication modules, terminals, communication solutions, and cloud products. The company employs a direct sales model supplemented by distribution channels and service operation models in urban IoT sensing. It also earns income from cloud platform deployment and cloud infrastructure sales, including storage and computing hardware and software solutions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading player in the smart grid wireless communication module market in China, holding over 50% market share in national grid procurement and leading in overseas smart grid markets such as India and Southeast Asia. It competes with domestic and international chip manufacturers and IoT solution providers, differentiating itself through integrated 'cloud-management-terminal' architecture and AI-enabled IoT products. It is recognized as a national-level specialized and innovative 'Little Giant' enterprise.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 3.07 billion, a 229.33% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 100.25 million, turning profitable after previous losses. Total assets reached RMB 1.77 billion, up 13.05%, with net assets of RMB 855 million, up 14.78%. The company’s R&D investment was RMB 95.15 million, accounting for 3.10% of revenue. The company shows strong growth driven by expanding cloud product sales and overseas market penetration.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers a unique integrated 'cloud-management-terminal' IoT architecture that covers the full data lifecycle from collection, transmission, cleaning, computing, to storage and disaster recovery. Its products emphasize stability, reliability, security, and low power consumption, tailored for diverse industrial, automotive, and urban applications. The deep integration of AI technologies into IoT modules and terminals enhances intelligent data processing and operational efficiency, providing differentiated solutions that support digital transformation and smart city initiatives.
